articles.summary: Online Contest Offers Texas Pre-K–12 Educators Chance to Win Share of $80,000 in Donations and Prizes On Oct. 5, 2026, World Teachers’ Day, Hilltop Securities Inc. (HilltopSecurities) will launch its sixth annual virtual Hilltop Hunt , inviting Texas prekindergarten through 12 th grade educators to participate in the statewide online Texas trivia competition. In honor of HilltopSecurities’ 80th anniversary of helping clients pursue their financial goals, this year’s Hilltop Hunt will provide $80,000 in donations and prizes to support Texas education foundations. Participating educators will have the opportunity to win a share of the $80,000 through the online contest. “The Hilltop Hunt is our way of celebrating the incredible work Texas educators do every day,” said HilltopSecurities President and CEO Brad Winges. “We know teachers invest so much of themselves in their students and communities, and we're proud to offer a fun opportunity to recognize their dedication while supporting
articles.title: HilltopSecurities Launches Sixth Annual Hilltop Hunt
